scenario: [LTIE.4.8]: the engine judges a `publish`'s values as it judges an `emit`'s, and "a `publish` the engine refuses sends nothing". Tier `edge` runs three firings, one pump each. Rule `nan_up` publishes `Sig v: (x.a - x.a)` over a Reading whose `a` is inf, so the value is NaN, computed from a slot so nothing folds it: a TypeError, as an `emit` of it is ([RARC.5.2.7], [LEXP.4.2]), and the pump reports no error, 0. Rule `long_up` publishes `Note s: "{t.text}{t.text}"` over a Trig whose `text` is five codepoints, so the value is ten against `capacity 8`: refused as a bound ([LSTR.11.3]), and the pump reports `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_BREACH`, -710. Rule `long_emit` is the control, an `emit` of the same value into a slot of the same `capacity`: -710 too. `expected_pump_statuses` pins all three ([RCTS.1.2.30]). Then `hub` takes whatever `edge` published (`forward`, [RCTS.1.2.29]) and pumps: it holds 0 facts. What it discriminates: a publish that sent its values unjudged gives `hub` a Sig or a Note, or `hub`'s own assert refuses the NaN or the long String and the step fails; a publish refused with another status than the emit's, or a runtime whose pump reports no status for either refusal, fails the statuses. PATH PINNED: libds's `ds_rete_publish_values` (rete/adapters.c), which judges the values before the publish callback runs, and `ds_rete_wm_assert`'s capacity refusal for the `emit`, each returned by the pump; the Mercury runtime's `ds.exec.publish_verb` and `assert_verb`, each raising its pump status through `lstr_11_3_pump_status`.

edge.rules_ds:
schema Reading scope explicit:
    id: String
    a: Float

schema Trig scope explicit:
    k: Int
    text: String

schema Line scope explicit:
    k: Int
    text: String

schema Sig scope explicit:
    v: Float

schema Note scope explicit:
    s: String capacity 8

schema Out scope explicit:
    s: String capacity 8

rule nan_up:
    Reading x
->
    publish Sig v: (x.a - x.a)

rule long_up:
    Trig t
->
    publish Note s: "{t.text}{t.text}"

rule long_emit:
    Line l
->
    emit Out s: "{l.text}{l.text}"

hub.rules_ds:
schema Sig scope explicit:
    v: Float

schema Note scope explicit:
    s: String capacity 8
